title: 第5章 地图册中的玄机
content_zh:
徐青回到出租屋时才发现一脸憔悴的秦冰居然还坐在客厅里低着头发呆，只能硬着头皮走上前挨训。

“嫂子，我回来了。”徐青耷拉着脑袋进了屋，一双眼睛紧盯着脚尖。

秦冰嘴唇颤动了两下，擦了擦干涩的眼角道：“还没吃早餐吧？我这就帮你做去。”说完起身就向厨房走。

“别，我在外面吃过了。”徐青连忙上前两步，伸手拦住了秦冰。瞧着嫂子一脸憔悴的模样，他心里一阵泛酸。

“哦！那你洗了脸睡一觉，我先去上班了。”秦冰表情有些木讷，慢慢的转过身拧起自己的小包向门外走去。

没有斥责，也没有太多言语，仿佛徐青从未离开过一样，但从她憔悴的面容不难看出，昨晚她分明一夜未眠。

等秦冰走了之后，徐青立刻从抽屉里翻出一把裁纸刀和一本新书来。他小心翼翼的把那本旧地图夹层剖开，果然里面有一张貌似邮票的四方纸片。

趁着电脑还没归还的当口，徐青赶紧上网查阅这张纸片历，查了许久终于在一个叫华邮网的站点找到了一枚和手中纸片模一样的邮票。

清大龙邮票之万年有象，为清朝大龙邮票母票之一，大象的背上是一盆万年青，代表着周而复始，生生不息。上方两只蝙蝠在飞舞，左上角是一堆云彩。蝠与“福”谐音，再加上云彩，更是“洪福齐天”，加上大象，就成了“洪福齐天之祥兆也”……

徐青憋着口气静静浏览着各种关于‘万年有象’的介绍，一颗心几乎蹦到了嗓子眼，最后当他见到频频出现的‘非常珍贵’‘珍贵无比’等字样时连手指也禁不住微微发颤起来。

浏览了一个小时资料后，徐青已经能确定手里这张八块钱买来的纸片就是大龙母票万年有象，而且品相保存完好，几乎还是张全新票，从网上得来的消息这张邮票拍卖到了近六十万港币，这才是最让他激动的。

别说六十万，就算是打个对折有三十万，解决掉目前窘迫的生活问题绰绰有余，徐青长舒了一口大气，从抽屉里翻出一个小塑料袋打开，小心的用刀片把邮票挑了进去，然后展开书页夹住了塑料袋，起身把书放进了自己书包。

刚做完这一切，桌上的小灵通响了，徐青抓起来接通，原来是二楼那位让他修电脑的，随口应了句，立刻关上了电脑，拔去插线，抱起来急匆匆下了楼。

才到二楼，那位姓刘的住户已经站在门口搓手等着了，这货又胖又矮，戴着副黑框眼镜儿，职业就是专写网络小说剧本啥的，收入还算不错，不过没有电脑就等于卡住了他脖子，急得他像热锅上的蚂蚁，大清早就开始打电话催了。

见到徐青过来，姓刘的赶紧冲上前帮手接过了机箱，一溜烟跑进了房里。

徐青瞧着这货肥膘乱颤，健步如飞，禁不住一阵愕然，笑着摇了摇头搬着显示器跟脚进了房间。

刘胖子虽说不会修电脑，但插线开机却轻车熟路，听得机箱里吡溜一声响显示屏顿时有了反应，胖脸上乐开了花，连声赞道：“哥们，行啊！一晚上工夫就把俺小三调教好了……”

徐青微微一愣，脑门上冒出几条黑线，什么小三调教，这都哪跟哪啊！

刘胖子笑眯眯的指了指电脑说道：“这就是咱小三，出了毛病被你整好了不是调教么？还别说，连风扇声音也小了不少。”

徐青恍然大悟，笑着说道：“CPU风扇上沾了一层灰，顺手用毛笔清干净了。”

刘胖子竖了个大拇指道：“敬业，你比那些修电脑的强多了，咯！二十大洋，以后有事了还找你。”说完掏出张二十块的纸币塞到了徐青手中。

徐青接过钱塞进口袋，装作漫不经心的问道：“刘哥，你知不知道江城这块有啥邮票交易的地方么？”

刘胖子微微一笑道：“哥们也集邮？”

徐清点了点头说道：“以前好这口，淘了几张邮票，现在想出手套点现钱。”

在他看来哪怕网上说那张邮票价值不菲，套不了现也是白搭，倒不如便宜点卖出去，起码自己上大学的费用有了着落，还能帮嫂子减轻负担。

刘胖子一边鼓捣着电脑，头也不回的说道：“我倒是认识一富二代哥们，他平时就喜欢鼓捣邮票古玩啥的，不过金猴票之类的普通货色他还真看不上眼，只要货好，钱不是问题。”

言下之意要是没什么好货色根本入不了那哥们的眼，刘胖子交游广阔，他口里所说的那富二代哥们老头子是山西煤老板中赫赫有名的人物，都说人一旦把钱变成数字后就喜欢增加点文化底蕴啥的，只要货好，钱就是王八蛋，这爷俩就是典型的这一类人。

徐青心头一阵狂跳，脸上却不动声色，笑了笑道：“不瞒刘哥，我那张邮票还真比猴票值钱多了，如果你那哥们肯出钱绝对让他有个惊喜。”

“哦！”刘胖子放下了鼠标，转过身来望着徐青满脸狐疑的说道：“真的？哥们你可别丢大的，你说说那邮票是啥名堂？”

“全新大龙邮票，万年有象。”徐青不愠不火的吐出了十个大字，刘胖子脸上的肥肉顿时抖了一抖，虽说他对邮票没啥研究，不过大龙邮票的名头只要稍有些见识的中国人都知道。

“哥们，你确定是大龙邮票？”刘胖子眼睛里闪出两点亮光，难以置信的又问了一遍，见到徐青点头，这货立刻拿起手机按下了一连串数字。

嘟嘟……手机接通，那头传来一个瓮声瓮气的声音：“麻痹的，大清早的吵我干毛？”声音的主人明显还在床上挣扎，张口就是一通埋怨。

刘胖子底气十足，对着电话叫开了：“不是我找你，是全新的大龙邮票找你……万年有象……”

“操，吃饱了撑的……”嘟嘟……那头骂了一句，立马挂了电话，刘胖子一脸苦笑的摇了摇头，他也想不通富二代为什么会挂了电话，或许大清早的扰人清梦挨骂也活该。

“算了，弄不好他已经有了这张邮票，那我先上去了。”徐青见刘胖子讨了个没趣，也不想在这里逗留，待会还要去打扫出租屋楼道，至于刘胖子说的什么富二代他也不会放在心上。
content_en:
When Xu Qing returned to the rental house, he found that Qin Bing, who looked haggard, was still sitting in the living room with his hair down, so he could only bite the bullet and step forward to be scolded.

"Sister-in-law, I'm back." Xu Qing entered the room with her head drooped, her eyes fixed on her toes.

Qin Bing's lips trembled twice, wiped the dry corners of his eyes and said, "You haven't had breakfast yet? I'll help you make it." After saying that, he stood up and walked to the kitchen.

"No, I've eaten outside." Xu Qing quickly took two steps forward and reached out to stop Qin Bing.Seeing his sister-in-law's haggard look, he felt sour in his heart.

"Oh! Then wash your face and get some sleep. I'll go to work first." Qin Bing's expression was dull, and he slowly turned around, picked up his small bag and walked out the door.

There was no rebuke or many words, as if Xu Qing had never left, but it was not difficult to tell from her haggard face that she had clearly stayed up all night last night.

After Qin Bing left, Xu Qing immediately took out a paper knife and a new book from the drawer.He carefully opened the old map and found a square piece of paper inside that looked like a stamp.

Before the computer was returned, Xu Qing hurriedly checked the paper calendar online. After searching for a long time, he finally found a stamp exactly like the piece of paper in his hand on a website called Huayou.com.

The Dalong stamp of the Qing Dynasty is one of the mother stamps of the Dalong stamp of the Qing Dynasty. There is a pot of evergreen on the elephant's back, which represents the cycle and endless life.Two bats are flying above, and a bunch of clouds are in the upper left corner.Bat and "Fu" are homophonic, together with the clouds, it means "the sky is filled with great blessings", plus the elephant, it becomes "the auspicious omen that the sky is filled with great blessings"...

Xu Qing held his breath and quietly browsed through various introductions about the 'Ten Thousand Years of Elephant', his heart almost leaping into his throat. Finally, when he saw the words 'very precious' and 'incomparably precious' that appeared frequently, even his fingers couldn't help but tremble slightly.

After browsing the information for an hour, Xu Qing was able to confirm that the piece of paper bought for eight yuan in his hand was the Great Dragon Mother stamp with ten thousand years of existence. It was also in good condition and was almost a brand new stamp. The news he got from the Internet was that this stamp was auctioned for nearly 600,000 Hong Kong dollars. This was what excited him the most.

Not to mention 600,000, even if it was folded in half, it would be 300,000, which was more than enough to solve the current embarrassing life problems. Xu Qing breathed a sigh of relief, took out a small plastic bag from the drawer, opened it, carefully picked out the stamps with a razor blade, then unfolded the pages of the book and sandwiched the plastic bag, stood up and put the book into his bag.

Just after finishing all this, the PHS on the table rang. Xu Qing grabbed it and connected it. It turned out to be the person on the second floor who asked him to repair the computer. He responded casually, immediately closed the computer, unplugged the cord, picked it up and hurried downstairs.

When we arrived on the second floor, the resident named Liu was already standing at the door, rubbing his hands and waiting. He was fat and short, wearing a pair of black-rimmed glasses. His occupation was writing online novels and scripts, and his income was pretty good. However, not having a computer was like a bottleneck, and he was as anxious as an ant on a hot pot. He started calling early in the morning to urge him.

Seeing Xu Qing coming over, the man surnamed Liu rushed forward to help take over the computer case and ran into the room.

Xu Qing couldn't help being stunned as he watched this guy's fat body tremble and move as fast as flying. He smiled, shook his head, and carried the monitor and feet into the room.

Although Fatty Liu didn't know how to repair computers, he was very familiar with plugging in the cables and turning it on. When he heard a popping sound in the computer case, the display screen immediately responded. Fatty's face lit up with joy, and he praised repeatedly: "Brother, that's good! I trained my mistress in one night..."

Xu Qing was slightly startled, and a few black lines appeared on his forehead. What kind of mistress training was there?

Fatty Liu pointed at the computer with a smile and said: "This is our mistress. When something went wrong, you corrected it, didn't it teach me? Not to mention, even the fan noise has been reduced a lot."

Xu Qing suddenly realized it and said with a smile: "There was a layer of dust on the CPU fan, so I cleaned it off with a brush."

Fatty Liu gave a thumbs up and said: "Jingye, you are much better than those who repair computers, huh! Twenty Days, I will come back to you if anything happens in the future." After saying that, he took out a twenty yuan note and stuffed it into Xu Qing's hand.

Xu Qing took the money and stuffed it into his pocket, pretending to be casual and asked: "Brother Liu, do you know if there is any stamp trading place in Jiangcheng?"

Fatty Liu smiled slightly and said, "Brother, do you also collect stamps?"

Xu Qing nodded and said: "I used to be good at this and bought a few stamps, but now I want to make some cash with gloves."

In his opinion, even if the stamp was said to be valuable online and could not be cashed out, it would be useless. It was better to sell it cheaper. At least he would be able to pay for college and help his sister-in-law reduce the burden.

Fatty Liu was tinkering with the computer and said without looking back: "I know a second-generation rich man. He usually likes to tinker with stamps and antiques, but he really doesn't like ordinary things like Golden Monkey Tickets. As long as the goods are good, money is not an issue."

The implication is that if there is no good stuff, it will never catch the eye of that buddy. Fatty Liu has a wide circle of friends. The old second-generation rich guy he talks about is a famous figure among Shanxi coal bosses. They say that once people turn money into numbers, they like to add some cultural heritage. As long as the goods are good, money is like a bastard. These two men are typical of this type of people.

Xu Qing's heart was beating wildly, but his face was calm. He smiled and said: "To be honest with Brother Liu, my stamp is really worth much more than the monkey stamp. If your buddy is willing to pay for it, he will definitely be surprised."

"Oh!" Fatty Liu put down the mouse, turned around and looked at Xu Qing and said with suspicion: "Really? Brother, don't throw it away. What's the name of that stamp?"

"The brand-new Dalong stamp has an image for thousands of years." Xu Qing spit out ten big characters calmly, and the fat on Fatty Liu's face suddenly shook. Although he had no research on stamps, the name of Dalong stamp is known to any Chinese with a little knowledge.

"Brother, are you sure it's the Dalong stamp?" Fatty Liu's eyes flashed with two lights, and he asked again in disbelief. When Xu Qing nodded, the guy immediately picked up his phone and pressed a series of numbers.

Beep...the phone was connected, and a rumbling voice came from the other end: "You idiot, are you disturbing me so early in the morning?" The owner of the voice was obviously still struggling on the bed, and he opened his mouth to complain.

Fatty Liu was so confident that he called into the phone: "I'm not looking for you, it's the brand new Dalong stamps that are looking for you... There will be an image every year..."

"Fuck, I'm so full..." Dudu... the other end cursed and immediately hung up the phone. Fatty Liu shook his head with a wry smile. He couldn't figure out why the rich second generation hung up the phone. Maybe he deserved to be scolded for disturbing his dreams so early in the morning.

"Forget it, maybe he already has this stamp, so I'll go up first." Xu Qing saw that Fatty Liu was bored and didn't want to stay here. He had to clean the corridor of the rental house later. As for the rich second generation that Fatty Liu said, he didn't take it to heart.
